panel.title: Measure
panel.empty: Pick a tool above and click on the model. Points snap to vertices, edge midpoints and edges.
panel.shortcutHint: M opens this panel · 1–5 switch tools

tools.pathHint: Length of a line through several points
tools.areaHint: Area of a polygon or of a face
tools.pointHint: X, Y, Z coordinates of a point

modes.perpendicularHint: From a face to a point, square to the face — for clearances
modes.faceHint: One click measures a whole face

steps.pick-face: Click a face to measure its area
steps.angle-first: Click a point on the first side
steps.angle-vertex: Click the vertex of the angle
steps.angle-end: Click a point on the second side
steps.pick-plane-face: Click the face to measure from
steps.perpendicular-target: Click the point to measure to
steps.point: Click a point to read its coordinates

keys.closeHint: Click the first point, double-click or right-click to close

snap.title: Snap to
snap.hint: Faces are always used. Turn a snap off to place points freely near corners.

settings.components: Show the X · Y · Z legs of every distance

item.perpendicularNote: Measured square to the reference face.
item.nonPlanar: The points are not on one plane: this is the projected area.
item.fromFace: Area of one face, measured along its outer edge.
item.modelFrame: Coordinates in the model's own IFC frame.
item.sceneFrame: Scene coordinates (no model under the point).

actions.copyAllHint: Copy every measurement as a table (pastes into a spreadsheet)
actions.copyFailed: The clipboard is not available here

section.title: Section
section.planHint: Horizontal cut through the model — keeps what is below
section.alongXHint: Vertical cut across the X axis
section.alongYHint: Vertical cut across the Y axis
section.faceHint: Click a face to cut along it
section.placing: Click a face of the model to cut along it
section.placingHint: What is between you and the face is removed · Esc to cancel
section.boxHint: Six faces around the model or the selected element. Drag them to isolate a room, a floor or a riser.
section.boxNeedsSelection: Select an element in the model first
section.position: Position — click to type a value
section.offset: Offset from the face — click to type a value
section.min: Minimum — click to type a value
section.max: Maximum — click to type a value
section.levelUp: Storey above (1.2 m over its floor)
section.levelDown: Storey below (1.2 m over its floor)
section.dragHint: Drag the arrows in the model to move a cut or a face of the box.
section.empty: Start with a plan cut, or put a section box around what you need to see.
section.noModel: Load a model to cut it

selection.note: Bounding box along the model axes.
